description.value: Ms Tiffin is a Vancouver Indian street food restaurant and tiffin subscription service founded in 2017 by Seema Nanda, offering bold dishes from crispy chaats and frankies to butter chicken poutine alongside home-style tiffin meal deliveries and a selection of mithai. Customer reviews praise the spacious, relaxed dining area and the authenticity of the food, which draws comparisons to roadside dhabas. The operation also handles wedding catering and group orders, making it a notable community hub for Indian cuisine in the city.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Ms Tiffin is an active Indian restaurant and tiffin-delivery service in Vancouver, with customer reviews describing a spacious dine-in canteen, and contact details (phone 604-677-4227, email info@mstiffin.ca) found on the About page — both absent from OSM tags. Vegetarian options are explicitly confirmed in the FAQ ('All tiffins are vegetarian by default'), and takeout/delivery is confirmed via DoorDash and Uber Eats integrations on the homepage. No bike-specific amenities (parking, pump, Wi-Fi, washrooms, etc.) are mentioned anywhere in the website content.
